scripts.build:js: uglifyjs node_modules/jquery/dist/jquery.js assets/js/plugins/jquery.fitvids.js assets/js/plugins/jquery.greedy-navigation.js assets/js/plugins/jquery.magnific-popup.js assets/js/plugins/jquery.ba-throttle-debounce.js assets/js/plugins/smooth-scroll.js assets/js/plugins/gumshoe.js assets/js/_main.js -c -m --comments "/^!|GreedyNav/" -o assets/js/main.min.js && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = 'assets/js/main.min.js'; fs.writeFileSync(path, fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8').replace(/[ \t]+$/gm, ''))"
scripts.build:search: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); for (const file of ['lunr.js', 'lunr.min.js']) fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/lunr/' + file, 'assets/js/lunr/' + file)"
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:search
